buckets.title: First steps
buckets.description: Give information a name. Make your first Python program.

buckets.title: Decisions & loops
buckets.description: Choose a path, repeat an action, and know when to stop.

buckets.title: Strings & data structures
buckets.description: Find the right home for a word, a list, or a collection.

buckets.title: Functions & scope
buckets.description: Build reusable pieces and understand where names belong.

buckets.title: Object-oriented Python
buckets.description: Turn related information and behavior into useful objects.

buckets.title: Files & exceptions
buckets.description: Keep data around and handle the unexpected.

buckets.title: Special topics
buckets.description: Explore algorithms, memory, visualization, and more.

concepts.title: Variables & assignment
concepts.description: Give a value a name and update it over time.

concepts.title: Data types
concepts.description: Choose numbers, text, and true-or-false values.

concepts.title: Keywords & identifiers
concepts.description: Discover reserved words and the rules for naming things.

concepts.title: Printing & built-in functions
concepts.description: Make information visible with a function call.

concepts.title: Arithmetic operators
concepts.description: Calculate quantities, totals, and remainders.

concepts.title: Comparisons & Boolean logic
concepts.description: Ask questions that evaluate to True or False.

concepts.title: If, elif & else
concepts.description: Make a different choice when the situation changes.

concepts.title: For loops & range
concepts.description: Repeat once for each item or a known number of times.

concepts.title: While loops
concepts.description: Keep going while a condition is true.

concepts.title: Break, continue & return
concepts.description: Learn when to stop, skip, or leave a function.

concepts.title: Nested loops
concepts.description: Repeat an action inside another repeating action.

concepts.title: Truthiness & short-circuiting
concepts.description: Understand how Python evaluates values in conditions.

concepts.title: Strings & text processing
concepts.description: Clean, split, join, and format everyday text.

concepts.title: Indexing & slicing
concepts.description: Retrieve a single item or a slice of a sequence.

concepts.title: Lists
concepts.description: Keep an ordered collection that can change.

concepts.title: Tuples & immutability
concepts.description: Store ordered records whose references stay fixed.

concepts.title: Sets
concepts.description: Keep unique items and compare groups.

concepts.title: Dictionaries & hashing
concepts.description: Connect a unique key directly to a value.

concepts.title: Defining & calling functions
concepts.description: Turn a repeated task into a reusable operation.

concepts.title: Scope & name resolution
concepts.description: Understand which name Python finds and where.

concepts.title: Closures & nested functions
concepts.description: Let a function remember the context that created it.

concepts.title: Recursion & backtracking
concepts.description: Solve a smaller version of a problem until a base case.

concepts.title: Classes & objects
concepts.description: Create many individual objects from one blueprint.

concepts.title: Encapsulation & data hiding
concepts.description: Group state with the methods that safely change it.

concepts.title: Inheritance
concepts.description: Reuse, override, and extend behavior from a parent class.

concepts.title: Polymorphism & duck typing
concepts.description: Send the same request to objects with different behavior.

concepts.title: Abstraction
concepts.description: Expose a simple operation while hiding implementation details.

concepts.title: File handling & persistence
concepts.description: Read and save information beyond a running program.

concepts.title: Exception handling
concepts.description: Recover from failures and clean up reliably.

concepts.title: Understanding Python errors
concepts.description: Recognize what an error means and choose a recovery.

concepts.title: Input validation
concepts.description: Check information before letting it through.

concepts.title: Sorting & searching
concepts.description: Arrange information and find what you need.

concepts.title: Filtering & counting
concepts.description: Keep matching items and summarize a collection.

concepts.title: Modules & imports
concepts.description: Organize and reuse code from another module.

concepts.title: Decorators
concepts.description: Wrap an operation with behavior before and after it.

concepts.title: Iterators & generators
concepts.description: Produce values on demand instead of all at once.

concepts.title: References, mutation & memory
concepts.description: Follow objects, references, and their lifetime.

concepts.title: Multithreading
concepts.description: Coordinate several tasks that spend time waiting.

concepts.title: Data visualization with Matplotlib
concepts.description: Choose a chart that answers the question.

concepts.title: Compilers & interpreters
concepts.description: Explore how a computer translates and executes code.

concepts.title: Dates & times
concepts.description: Order events and reason about a timeline.

concepts.title: Comprehensions
concepts.description: A dedicated story for list, set, and dictionary comprehensions.

concepts.title: Regular expressions
concepts.description: Find and validate text patterns with Python’s re module.

concepts.title: JSON & CSV serialization
concepts.description: Move structured information between files and Python objects.

concepts.title: Testing Python code
concepts.description: Write assertions, test edge cases, and learn unit testing.

concepts.title: Type hints
concepts.description: Describe the inputs and outputs of Python code with annotations.

concepts.title: Dataclasses
concepts.description: Model records with generated initialization and comparison methods.

concepts.title: Async / await & asyncio
concepts.description: Coordinate waiting tasks using coroutines and an event loop.

concepts.title: HTTP requests & APIs
concepts.description: Request data from a service and handle its responses.

concepts.title: SQLite & databases
concepts.description: Store, query, and update persistent records using SQL.

concepts.title: Packages, pip & virtual environments
concepts.description: Set up a reproducible Python environment and install packages.

concepts.title: Custom context managers
concepts.description: Design resource cleanup with __enter__, __exit__, and contextlib.
